t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Orange green red and blue gnomes take you to the bright forest and the other colours take you to the dark forest but other details about the gnomes are irrelevant, the goal is to get as many mushrooms as possible so look for patterns

vb_textbox.text: The gnomes always come in colour pairs: orange and brown, green and pink, red and yellow and blue and purple. Orange, green, red and blue send you to a dark forest and brown, pink, yellow and purple send you to a light forest. The shape and size of the gnomes are irrelevant: only the colours matter. You have to consistently pick the forest that gives you the higher number of mushrooms. You will also get timed out for clicking too slowly, so try and be quick.
